description:
This week on the podcast, we dive into Marvel Comics’ Wolverine: Weapons of Armageddon with writer Chip Zdarsky and artist Luca Maresca. Plus, we sit down with Kristy Amornkul to learn all about her role and responsibilities as Director of Franchise and Marketing at Marvel Studios. And finally, we set our sights on the deadliest Daredevil villain, Bullseye, with a full comic book character breakdown.  All time codes approximate.
